description:
Measure what your text costs as a binary SIGIL stream beside compact JSON, gzip JSON and a conventional encrypted chunked upload, and how many concepts each byte carries (density: tokens per stream byte against words per JSON byte).
Use it to test the efficiency claim on your own material before adopting the stream. Not for deliberating (use frame_deliberation); to get the stream itself, an admitted key and encode_stream.
Behavior: no key; the text is measured in memory and discarded, and only a daily count with byte and token totals is kept (shown publicly in buckets of 20 or more). Limit: 120 calls per minute per address, 600 with a key, shared across all MCP calls; past it, an error with retry_after. Text over 64 KB is refused.
Inputs: text is what gets encoded, in your own words or a record rendered as words. record, if given, is the JSON you would otherwise send, and becomes the JSON baseline. certainty (0 to 1, default 1) rides inside every token instead of as a separate field.

certainty.description: optional, default 1: carried inside every token

record.description: optional: the JSON you would otherwise send; it becomes the JSON baseline

text.description: Your own text, up to 64 KB

name: measure_stream
title: Measure the SIGIL stream against JSON
